summary: Frontend-only retest of click-to-open event popup (EventList.tsx). 28/28 Playwright checks passed on /esemenyek, home (home-events-list) and /tagintezmenyek/kisbaconi-ovoda: hovering a row for 1.2s does not open the popup; click and Enter open it with title/date/location/institution/description; X, Esc and backdrop all close it, and it stays closed when the cursor goes back over a row (iteration_5 reopen bug fixed); moving the mouse out of the card does not close it; the past row (Tanévnyitó) does not open on hover or click; the HU and RO intro texts are updated and the RO popup shows the RO title.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor a11y: rows have role=button but only handle Enter, not Space. Consider also handling e.key === ' ' (with preventDefault). The popup also lacks role=dialog/aria-modal and focus management.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The popup is now click-only, so parking the mouse is no longer needed. Event IDs: Szülői 798ec223, Mikulás e053c87a, Karácsonyi bece7097, Tanévnyitó a8c6f703 (past). Server date 2026-10-30. Lang switch: lang-switch-ro / lang-switch-hu.
